assumptions.claim: The normalized target and statementHash are aligned with NO-LOG.
BLT C0 has rational Jacobian torsion of 5-rank 2.
The monic odd model g is squarefree and its projective branch form has irreducible-factor degrees 1,1,4.
KL Theorem 4.1 supplies a thin exceptional set and the class-rank lower bound.
The proof of KL Theorem 1.3 supplies bad-prime ramification, imaginary sign, unit-rank correction, and degree-six discriminant height.
KL Lemma 3.1 encodes all fixed local neighborhoods in one positive congruence cone.
The free sufficiently-large N1 in KL Lemma 3.1 can avoid both branch endpoints, so the transformed F has nonzero leading and trailing coefficients without a later cone-changing transform.
The PGL2(Q) branch-coordinate change preserves separability and factor degrees 1,1,4.
ST absorbs the maximal fixed square w^2 for the selected congruence class and does not require w=1.
Every counted squarefree t can be assigned a witness with 1<=a,b<=H in the same positive congruence box.
A thin subset of Q has O(H) elements of height O(H).
For the even degree-six homogeneous form, a fixed projective parameter determines at most one signed squarefree class; hence thin deletion removes only O(H) counted t.
Distinct negative squarefree t give distinct imaginary quadratic fields.
The box bound gives |Disc(Q(sqrt(t)))| <= C_Delta H^6.
A Lean kernel receipt exists for the analytic replacement argument.
